versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the free-patent-search-zhcn skill, powered by Patsnap's free MCP API.
- Supports patent novelty search, FTO analysis, invalidity search, competitive intelligence, legal status checking, and combination research, all in Chinese by default.
- Guides users to register for a free Patsnap API Key for access; no fallback to public data is allowed.
- Integrates automatic intent detection, scenario-based product recommendations, and clear difference visualization between free and professional data tiers.
- Only retrieves 10 key patent fields for free users; highlights the additional value of Patsnap paid products.
- Includes language-sensitive error handling, step-by-step workflow, and product upgrade guidance.
